modal_branding: GODEVI develops digital-based destination marketing and branding strategies supported by the latest data trends and global practice standards. We deliver tangible results through partnerships with leading technology companies, content specialists, and storytellers with proven industry experience. We also provide a marketplace system on our website and application to connect tourism products with local to global markets in real time. To expand the market, GODEVI consistently builds access to a broad network of global partners in media, OTAs, travel, hospitality, tour operators, and specialist distribution channels.
modal_internship: GODEVI, as a tourism startup, offers internship opportunities and in-depth experience for students to grow together in advancing tourism in Indonesia, rooted in the concepts of Sustainability, Empowerment, and Entrepreneurship.
modal_planning:
GODEVI understands that tourism development is highly complex and dynamic, requiring a multidisciplinary approach to produce the right planning model. GODEVI is experienced in formulating policy recommendation strategies for governments to effectively develop integrated, quality tourism. To ensure superior practical policies, we collaborate with a number of experts from tourism education institutions in Bali, tourism associations, and the industry to develop strategies focused on identifying sustainable competitive advantages from environmental, cultural, and socio-economic perspectives.

We help clients understand how dynamic shifts in tourism trends and sustainability will affect their business — especially positioning, forecasting, performance, reputation, and overall competitiveness. We involve local stakeholders in the planning document development process to capture holistic local insights. Our deliverables can take the form of actionable plans, mapping designs, and public policy papers.
modal_project:
GODEVI acts as your extension team to help design, facilitate, empower, and provide the tools you need to successfully manage research-based projects. We listen, understand, and focus on your specific needs. We support our clients in implementing strategies by tailoring the solutions we offer to create measurable and sustainable results.

We have partnerships with a broad network of global travel and tourism organizations and specialist consultants, which enables us to deliver integrated solutions to our clients. We also partner with technology companies to provide innovative solutions that deliver real benefits.
modal_research: GODEVI provides research and scientific consulting services to support data-driven decision making in village tourism development. We help governments, academics, and business actors in preparing studies, data analysis, and scientific reviews that are valid and reliable — from identifying destination potential, assessing socio-economic impacts, to evaluating tourism policies. With rigorous research methodology, collaboration with experts, and the utilization of the latest analytical technology, GODEVI delivers comprehensive insights to realize sustainable, evidence-based village tourism development.
modal_sdm: All of the tourism potential and opportunities held by a destination — especially Indonesia's rural villages — require creative, innovative, and productive human resources to package the uniqueness of each rural area. GODEVI's training programs are here to answer the challenges of the Industrial Revolution 4.0 by producing technology-oriented tourism human resources for villages.
modal_tren: The fluctuating, dynamic nature of global tourism development — which remains vulnerable to crises — requires tourism stakeholders to make strategic decisions quickly and accurately. To support this, GODEVI offers a database of tourism trends and insights that is valid, reliable, and up to date, helping decision makers and tourism business managers choose the right decisions. To produce quality data, GODEVI uses data analysis methods supported by various technology-based software.
